# React components

Airbus Design System React Components

## Introduction

This package implements react UI components based on the Airbus Design System : [https://design-system.airbus.corp/](https://design-system.airbus.corp/) (goto/design-system).

User documentation can be found here : https://react.design-system.airbus.corp/

## 3rd party licenses

Projects consuming this package do not have to include them, and are not subject to their licenses.

## Build

Building the component library

```bash
npm run build
```

Building the documentation

```bash
npm run build-storybook
```

## Test

### Unit tests

Unit and html snapshot tests are available via jest

```bash
npm run test
```

Running html snapshot tests alone

```bash
npm run test-snap
```

### Visual regression

Visual regression tests are available via @storybook/test-runner

Before running the tests, you have to build storybook. Tests will execute by running chromium or chrome browser loading /storybook-static throuh http-server locally.

```bash
npm run build-storybook
npm run static-storybook
```

Then you can run visual regression tests for Airbus and Skywise stories

```bash
PORT=3000 npm run test-visual-airbus
PORT=3000 npm run test-visual-skywise
```

To update snapshots add `-u` flag

```bash
PORT=3000 npm run test-visual-airbus -- -u
PORT=3000 npm run test-visual-skywise -- -u
```

### Performance tests

Some experimental performance tests have been implemented with [reassure](https://callstack.github.io/reassure/)

To set baseline peformance results (should be done on a reference machine like jenkins slave)

```bash
npx reassure --baseline
````

To compare with current code performance

```bash
npx reassure
```

### Running a single test suite

```bash
npm run test src/components/Button/Button.test.tsx
STORY=Button npm run test-visual-airbus
STORY="Anchor Navigation" npm run test-visual-airbus
```
